metadata.title: Santa Clarita Valley community boundaries
metadata.description: Los Angeles County Countywide Statistical Area (CSA) polygons, filtered to the communities that match SCVHistory.com Community terms. properties.slug matches the Craft category slug in the neighborhood group.
metadata.source: Los Angeles County Enterprise GIS (eGIS), eGISBOS Countywide Statistical Areas
metadata.attribution: Los Angeles County Enterprise GIS (eGIS), egis@isd.lacounty.gov
metadata.license: NEEDS_VERIFICATION. The ArcGIS item carries no licenseInfo statement. Published as LA County open data; confirm the portal terms of use before public launch.
metadata.query: outSR=4326, maxAllowableOffset=0.0002, geometryPrecision=5, where COMMUNITY IN (14 names) OR LCITY='Santa Clarita'
caveats: Newhall, Saugus, Valencia and Canyon Country CSAs cover only the unincorporated remnants of those communities. The bulk of each lies inside the City of Santa Clarita polygon.
san-francisquito-canyon uses the combined "San Francisquito Canyon/Bouquet Canyon" CSA, which overlaps the separate bouquet-canyon polygon.

Communities with no LA County CSA polygon are absent from this file by design. They are the canyons and historic townsites with no official boundary, and the Ventura and Kern county communities that this LA County dataset does not cover.
metadata.neighbors_method: properties.neighbors is derived from these simplified polygons: two communities are listed as neighbours when any boundary vertex of one lies within 250 m of a boundary segment of the other. It is a proximity test on generalised geometry, not a topological adjacency computation, so it can miss a narrow touch or include a near miss.

properties.name: Canyon Country
properties.note: CSA covers the unincorporated portion only. Most of Canyon Country lies inside the City of Santa Clarita.

properties.name: Newhall
properties.note: CSA covers the unincorporated portion only. Most of historic Newhall lies inside the City of Santa Clarita.

properties.name: San Francisquito Canyon
properties.note: Source polygon is the combined CSA "San Francisquito Canyon/Bouquet Canyon". It also covers Bouquet Canyon, which has its own separate CSA polygon in this file.

properties.name: Santa Clarita
properties.note: City of Santa Clarita boundary. Incorporated 1987; it contains Newhall, Saugus, Valencia and Canyon Country.

properties.name: Saugus
properties.note: CSA covers the unincorporated portion only. Most of historic Saugus lies inside the City of Santa Clarita.

properties.name: Valencia
properties.note: CSA covers the unincorporated portion only. Most of Valencia lies inside the City of Santa Clarita.
